name: mq9-reaper-sim
description: MQ-9 Reaper flight simulation on a CesiumJS globe with a free observer camera

scripts.predev: node scripts/copy-cesium-assets.mjs && node scripts/make-mq9.mjs && node scripts/prepare-trajectory.mjs
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/copy-cesium-assets.mjs && node scripts/make-mq9.mjs && node scripts/prepare-trajectory.mjs
scripts.demo:odesa-rf: npm run generate:odesa-rf && python3 -m rf_fusion.cli --scenario outputs/odesa/scenario.json --output outputs/odesa --diagnostics outputs/odesa/rf_diagnostics.json && python3 -m rf_fusion.validate_export outputs/odesa
scripts.demo:rf: npm run generate:rf && npm run validate:rf && python3 -m rf_fusion.cli --scenario outputs/mock_60s/scenario.json --output outputs/mock_60s --diagnostics outputs/mock_60s/rf_diagnostics.json
